8p-32.label: Gen 8 prototype (32): 7s-32 + the play read at exponent 1.0 at every trick (early 1.0, deal list 1.0)

9r-32.label: Gen 9 (E9-11): 8p-32 plus the replay reader: the house bidder (Gen 6) replayed on the pool after the opening lead, for the common bidder and each side's own

9c-32.label: Gen 9 (E9-12): 8p-32 reading the auction through the declared card rb-precision (the 'card' profile), for auctions bid by the rule bidder's precision settings (--book)

9x-32.label: Gen 9 (E9-12): 8p-32 reading the auction by replaying the rule bidder (precision settings) on the pool after the opening lead, the scorer drawing the pool

9u-32.label: Gen 9 (E9-12 slice): 8p-32 not reading the auction at all (the 'card' profile with no card: uniform over the hidden hands' types)

guest-a.label: guest-a (G9-D6): bids the rule bidder's precision settings; plays as 8p-32 with its own carding (configs/carding/guest-a.json play block, sam, 45da301)

guest-b.label: guest-b (G9-D6): bids the house Gen 5 bidder; plays as 8p-32 with its own carding (configs/carding/guest-b.json play block, sam, 45da301)

9cs-32.label: Gen 9 (E9-12 slice): 8p-32 reading the auction through the declared card rb-standard (the 'card' profile), for auctions bid by the rule bidder's standard settings (--book)

9xs-32.label: Gen 9 (E9-12 slice): 8p-32 reading the auction by replaying the rule bidder (standard settings) on the pool after the opening lead, the scorer drawing the pool
